basis: Codex directly viewed all 56 training contact sheets (ERP plus six overlapping perspectives), then six 60-degree zooms; no external VLM or CLIP predictions used to author this vocabulary.

classes.definition: 输送管路的直管、弯头、三通、保温包覆及无独立可见执行器的管件；排除阀执行器、仪表、风道和独立封闭容器。
prompts: industrial pipes and pipe fittings
white insulated pipes with large curved elbows
parallel cylindrical pipes running overhead
a smooth pale pipe with wrapped joints and a flow direction label
thick insulated plumbing connected around industrial equipment
small metal fluid pipes beside larger insulated pipes

classes.definition: 安装于管路的手轮、阀杆、短扳柄和有明确轴连接的执行器；普通法兰和包覆管件仍归管道。
prompts: an industrial pipe valve
a circular handwheel controlling a valve on a pipe
a black valve wheel attached to a blue gearbox
a red metal valve wheel with a short stem
an orange valve actuator mounted on an insulated pipe
a small lever operated valve on a thin metal pipe

classes.definition: 可辨电机肋片、驱动外壳及泵体组成的机组；合并紧密连接且难以可靠分界的泵和电机，不包含混凝土基础和整段外接管道。
prompts: an industrial pump and electric motor assembly
a black vertical electric motor with cooling fins
a motor driven pump connected to insulated pipes
a black ribbed motor standing above a round pump casing
a compact red and black circulation pump
a vertical pump motor with an attached rectangular drive housing
traits: 与管路连接但不是仅凭连接判定

classes.definition: 圆形指针表和有纵向刻度的细长温度计类仪表；不推断测量值，排除阀位箱、管道标签和控制屏幕。
prompts: an analog industrial gauge mounted on a pipe
a round pressure gauge with a white dial and a pointer
a circular metal instrument at the end of a narrow pipe
a slim yellow industrial thermometer with a vertical scale
a small measuring instrument attached to insulated plumbing
classes.uncertainty: 官方大类映射非精确仪表标签；小像素物体易混淆。

classes.definition: 独立封闭圆筒，包括有圆顶和支脚的蓝罐、带小接口和侧管的银色筒体；具体储存、缓冲或分离用途未确认，不包括贯通弯管和结构柱。
prompts: a closed cylindrical industrial vessel
a tall blue metal tank with a rounded closed top
a freestanding cylindrical tank on short support legs
a sealed metal vessel with small fittings and a pipe connection
a silver vertical cylindrical vessel with a flat closed lid
classes.uncertainty: 容器形状可靠，具体工艺用途不确定。

classes.definition: 柜式或箱式设备外壳、独立控制台、插座接线箱及开壳柜式机械单元；不假定所有白门板都是电气柜。排除已明确为泵机组的附属驱动盒、建筑门和管道。
prompts: an industrial equipment cabinet
a white metal enclosure with doors and black handles
an electrical control cabinet with switches and a display
a small industrial socket box with blue and red connectors
a large cabinet shaped equipment housing with removable panels
an open machinery enclosure with metal panels
a compact control console in an industrial plant room
classes.uncertainty: 统一可见外壳形态，避免无证据地将柜式机械设备叫电气柜；不是覆盖所有机器的machine类。

classes.definition: 承载电线电缆的开放网篮或线槽，包含其内线束；不包含人行格栅和细钢支架。
prompts: an overhead industrial cable tray
a wire mesh basket carrying parallel electrical cables
an open metal cable rack under the ceiling
bundles of dark and pale wires inside a galvanized wire tray
a narrow wire cable basket crossing above machinery

classes.definition: 可见银色波纹或分节圆风管、矩形送风通道；不将旁边独立银筒容器纳入风道。
prompts: an industrial ventilation duct
a silver corrugated round air duct
a metallic ventilation duct with segmented elbows
a large rectangular galvanized air duct below the ceiling
a shiny sheet metal air channel running across a plant room

classes.definition: 从地面延伸至顶部的粗结构支柱；场景常见红漆圆柱、黑色上端；不依据红色单独判定，也不含薄钢支架。
prompts: a structural support column inside a building
a thick cylindrical building pillar extending from floor to ceiling
a red painted round column in an industrial room
a solid architectural pillar beside industrial pipes
a large smooth concrete support column
classes.uncertainty: CIVILS为建筑结构上层映射，不是官方逐像素柱标签。

classes.definition: 支承管线设备的细金属柱、打孔槽钢、角钢、横梁及钢底座；不含建筑粗柱、护栏、梯子和承缆网篮。
prompts: a metal support frame for industrial equipment
a slender galvanized steel post with rows of holes
perforated steel channels supporting overhead pipes
a bolted metal upright with a flat foot plate
steel brackets and support beams around industrial machinery

classes.definition: 竖直梯级、梯侧梁及其安全笼；排除有宽踏面的楼梯和水平走台。
prompts: a vertical industrial access ladder
a metal ladder with horizontal rungs
a galvanized safety cage ladder leading to a maintenance platform
a vertical ladder surrounded by circular protective hoops

classes.definition: 有连续宽踏步的阶梯；不包含单一设备基座和仅有横杆的竖梯。
prompts: an indoor stairway
a short flight of gray concrete steps
wide stair treads leading up to a doorway
industrial access stairs beside a metal handrail

classes.definition: 围住设备、通道或楼梯的水平/斜扶手及立柱；不含管路、承重支架和安全笼梯。
prompts: a metal safety guardrail
a silver handrail along industrial access steps
horizontal metal rails around a recessed equipment area
a protective railing with upright posts and tubular bars

classes.definition: 可供站立的检修走台网格踏面；区别于内部承载电缆的窄网篮。
prompts: an industrial maintenance platform grating
a metal mesh walkway above equipment
a steel grating floor on an elevated access platform
a rigid grid of metal bars forming a service platform
classes.uncertainty: 多从底面观察，面积小，与电缆桥架密集重叠。

classes.definition: 灰色地坪、混凝土凸台和粗糙土建基础；不含连续楼梯、钢制底架和泵体。
prompts: a concrete industrial floor
a gray painted floor with scuffs and stains
a raised concrete equipment foundation beside a walkway
a plant room floor with yellow and black edge markings
the horizontal ground surface underneath machinery

classes.definition: 建筑竖直平墙及其饰面；场景常见下红上黑的墙；不含圆柱、白机柜板和门。
prompts: an interior building wall
a flat painted wall in an industrial plant room
a red wall with a dark upper section
a solid vertical architectural wall behind machinery
a painted concrete wall surface

classes.definition: 管线后方可见的建筑顶部表面；不含顶部密集管道、桥架和风道。
prompts: the ceiling of an industrial room
a dark ceiling surface above pipes
a black painted overhead building surface
the flat roof interior behind industrial installations

classes.definition: 供人员通行的建筑门及门框；不含设备柜门板。
prompts: an entrance door in an industrial building
a doorway with a dark metal frame
a building access door at the top of a short stairway
a rectangular door opening leading to another room

classes.definition: 白色发光长条及灯具壳体；不含风管或管道的反光。
prompts: an industrial strip light fixture
a bright elongated white ceiling light
a vertical fluorescent tube light beside equipment
a narrow luminous lamp beneath a cable tray

classes.definition: 可辨蓝白软包装袋堆；内容不明，不推断为具体化学品或材料。
prompts: a stack of material sacks
blue and white bags stacked in an industrial room
soft rectangular storage sacks with folded edges
piled bagged supplies beside industrial machinery

excluded_candidates.sign: 退出标志和管道标签可见，但像素小且用途异质；本版不作为独立训练类。
excluded_candidates.misc_object: 入口清洁小车、零散纸张、碎布及摄影三脚架仅保留观察记录，不将摄影伪影或稀少杂物强行设类。

mapping_note: Official IDs are category-level semantic references, not per-pixel GT assignments. A many-to-many or approximate mapping is explicitly allowed; no official masks enter training.
